reviews.title: I wished it would work!
reviews.text: I tried to get this app to accept my home airport. I kept getting error messages - no help from the help buttons or response from the company. I canceled my “Pro” subscription.

reviews.title: Can’t get app to work and no place to get any support
reviews.text: I thought I’d try the app out with a recent trip but nothing on it works for me when I hit app supper I get sent to my account but no place to get any assistance with my problems. My phone is up to date and new so maybe the app needs to be updated for the latest IOS but I canceled my subscription before the trial period ended because it’s just too frustrating.

reviews.title: No warning.  Subscribed
reviews.text: I signed up for a trial and was charged for a subscription without warning.  Useless and expensive.  Now I’m subscribed for a year.

reviews.title: Drains battery abnormally
reviews.text: 6m background drains 30% of battery on iPhone 18 Pro.

reviews.title: Can’t manually add hotel
reviews.text: Hard stop on this app was the inability to manually add a hotel.  Instead, required access to my email and reservation info. No thanks. I’m not that share-y

reviews.title: Want to love but unusable
reviews.text:
Application does not import itineraries very well. And when it does, doesn’t understand the information in the itinerary (reservation for a restaurant with confirmation number and I am continually prompted to make a reservation). 

Manually entered data like confirmation numbers and subtitles disappears (trying to figure out a secret) and I get timeout errors anytime I search for anything.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: I really wanted to use this app, but nothing in it works! Yes, it’s updated. I can’t view Pro Pricing, I can’t invite anyone to the trip, I can’t do anything. There’s always a “time out error”. Was this built by beginners? I tried deleting and redownloading the app too. Disappointing to say the least.

reviews.title: Syncing difficulties
reviews.text: I think this app has a great idea but it doesnt fulfill. Not everything synchs from email and what does comes thru with multiple. I also think the synching creates multiples in my Google Calendar.. The in app experience is clumsy and not easy to navigate. I even paid for the app as i thought maybe it was just the free version that had bugs Disappointed as I really wanted to like this

reviews.title: Years later and still no dark mode included
reviews.text: I reviewed this a while ago that it is a great app but there was no dark mode included for free. To this day this is still the case. It is unacceptable that an app does not include a dark mode when the ENTIRE OS has a dark mode. This should be standard, and not be a paid feature. I appreciate that it took a while to perfect by the developer. But we’re talking choosing colors. And that was years ago. Just include it in the base version now.

reviews.title: Too many popups
reviews.text: I don’t understand why developers think spamming people with popups is a good idea. It’s like I’m using the obnoxious Temu app or something. I didn’t even get a chance to use this because there’s no way I’m going to subject my friends to this just to keep track of an itinerary.

reviews.title: Less than useless
reviews.text: I sent every email I had about my trip. The airline booking and hotels were fine, everything else it ignored. Now I have to go through everything manually. I have so many  restaurants and tours planned this thing should all of that for me. Now it is a total waste of my time. And to think I just paid for the yearly plan. Ugh!
